# External Sources Log

All external figures used in the analysis trace to one of these named, published sources.
Accessed on 2026-06-02.

## ADREC (Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre) and DARI

- ADREC official portal: https://adrec.gov.ae/en/property_and_index
- ADREC Market Reports landing: https://adrec.gov.ae/en/Market_Reports
- ADREC 2025 Full-Year Report (third-party summary): https://www.mpinv.ae/article/abu-dhabi-real-estate-market-report-2025-record-aed-142-billion-in-transactions
- ADREC H1 2025 Report (third-party summary): https://knightsbridge-partners.com/market-report/adrec-abu-dhabi-real-estate-market-report-h1-2025/
- Abu Dhabi Real Estate Market Report 2025 (extended summary): https://abu-dhabi.realestate/blog/abu-dhabi-real-estate-market-report-2025/

Key figures extracted: total transactions AED 142B (+44% YoY 2025), residential sales AED 76.1B / 23,600 units (+67% value, +55% volume), off-plan share 58% of total / 71% of residential, 87% cash, 50%+ residential value to expats / FDI, Hudayriyat reached AED 12.5B (second-largest area).

## ValuStrat / Bayut / Engel & Volkers (rental yields and price growth)

- Bayut Abu Dhabi Rental Report H1 2025: https://www.bayut.com/mybayut/abu-dhabi-rental-market-report-h1-2025/
- Engel & Volkers Abu Dhabi market overview: https://www.engelvoelkers.com/ae/en/resources/abu-dhabi-property-market
- Sands of Wealth area-level yields (apartments): https://sandsofwealth.com/blogs/news/abu-dhabi-rental-yields-apartment
- MPInvestments Abu Dhabi Rental Market Report 2025: https://www.mpinv.ae/article/abu-dhabi-rental-market-report-2025-yields-trends-and-top-areas-for-landlords
- H2O Properties yields review 2025: https://www.h2o-properties.ae/post/rental-yields-in-abu-dhabi-2025-best-areas-for-high-roi
- Global Property Guide UAE: https://www.globalpropertyguide.com/middle-east/united-arab-emirates/rental-yields

Key figures: gross yields Yas Island apartments 7.1% / villas 5.5%, Saadiyat 5-6% (Saadiyat 2-bed apartments only 2.5% gross), Al Reem apartments 7.6% with mid-tier ~7.49% (net 5.7-6.6%). Rents Yas +15%, Saadiyat +14% in 2025. Citywide apartment gross yields 6-8%.

## Cushman & Wakefield Core, Cavendish Maxwell (forecasts)

- Cushman & Wakefield Core via Arabian Business: https://www.arabianbusiness.com/real-estate/abu-dhabi-home-prices-tipped-to-rise-16-per-cent-in-2026-as-apartments-set-to-outperform-villas
- Cavendish Maxwell Q1 2025 residential performance: https://cavendishmaxwell.com/insights/reports-and-whitepapers/abu-dhabi-residential-market-performance-q1-2025

Key figures: forecast 2026 +5-8% citywide (moderation from +12-22% in 2024-2025); apartment outperformance expected.

## Forward pipeline and infrastructure

- UAE President 13-project launch announcement (40,000 homes, AED 106B): https://www.mediaoffice.abudhabi/en/government-affairs/uae-president-witnesses-launch-of-13-new-projects-to-deliver-over-40000-homes-residential-plots-for-citizens-in-abu-dhabi-emirate-at-cost-of-aed106-billion/
- Nasluxury 2026 pipeline review: https://nasluxury.com/blogs/new-off-plan-projects-in-abu-dhabi-navigating-the-2026-residential-revolution/
- Khaleej Times market update (March 2026): https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/property/abu-dhabi-property-market-defies-uncertainty-records-over-1-billion-in-weekly-deals-in-march
- Arabian Post project approval streamlining: https://thearabianpost.com/abu-dhabi-streamlines-project-approvals/

Key figures: Aldar/Bloom/Modon will deliver 14,444 units (AED 55.38B) across 6 AD city communities; Al Ain partnership 10,480 units (AED 36.95B). Ethir by Aldar in Saadiyat Lagoons handover Q2 2026. Disney World Abu Dhabi announcement is the demand catalyst on Yas Island.

## Freehold zone authority

The freehold whitelist in `config.yaml` matches Abu Dhabi's designated investment zones where foreign Golden Visa holders may purchase. Verified informally against Engel & Volkers, Bayut, and Aldar developer documentation. No single official government URL was located in this run; the whitelist should be reconfirmed against ADREC's official investment zone designation when buying.
